messages.content:
다음 날 아침, 어제 그 카페 계산대다.
아이스 아메리카노를 시키고 카드를 댔는데 두 번이나 거절됐다.
지갑 속 현금은 눈으로 봐도 조금 모자란다.
Mia: Oh, hi again. Hmm, it still says declined. Do you have another card?
Owen: Sorry, I have a meeting in ten minutes. Is this going to take long?
I have no other card. Can I pay with my phone? Owen, I am sorry for the wait.

Mia: Yes, you can pay with your phone. Please open your payment app and tap it here.
Owen: That is okay. Please try your phone.
Before I pay, do you remember how I wanted my coffee yesterday?

Mia: Yes. You wanted your iced Americano with only a little ice yesterday. I remember.
Owen: That sounds good, but please pay with your phone now. I really need to go.
Owen, I know you are in a hurry. Can you wait one more minute, or do you need to go now?

Owen: I can wait one more minute. Please try your phone now.
Mia: Thanks, Owen. Your drink is ready, but I still need the payment first.
Mia, I have opened my payment app, but I have not tapped yet. Where should I hold my phone? Owen, thanks for waiting.

Mia: Hold the top of your phone over the small reader here. You will hear a beep.
Owen: No problem. I can wait while you pay.
Mia, I have tapped my phone and heard the beep. Did the payment go through? Owen, thank you for giving me a minute.

rubric: 회의는 Owen의 일정이다. 사용자에게 회의가 있다고 말하지 않는다.
사용자가 폰을 대고 소리를 들었다. 원래 음료를 건네며 성공으로 종료할 수 있다.
어제의 적은 얼음 선호가 다른 인물에게 옮겨지지 않는다.

지갑 속 현금은 눈으로 봐도 조금 모자란다.
Mia: Oh, hi again. Hmm, it still says declined. Do you have another card?
Owen: Sorry, I have a meeting in ten minutes. Is this going to take long?
I have no other card. Can I pay with my phone? Owen, I am sorry for the wait.

Mia: Yes, you can pay with your phone. Please open your payment app and tap it here.
Owen: That is okay. Please try your phone.
Before I pay, do you remember how I wanted my coffee yesterday?

Mia: Yes. You wanted your iced Americano with only a little ice yesterday. I remember.
Owen: That sounds good, but please pay with your phone now. I really need to go.
Owen, I know you are in a hurry. Can you wait one more minute, or do you need to go now?

Owen: I can wait one more minute. Please try your phone now.
Mia: Thanks, Owen. Your drink is ready, but I still need the payment first.
Mia, I have opened my payment app, but I have not tapped yet. Where should I hold my phone? Owen, thanks for waiting.

Mia: Hold the top of your phone over the small reader here. You will hear a beep.

Owen: That is okay. Please try your phone.
Before I pay, do you remember how I wanted my coffee yesterday?

Owen: That sounds good, but please pay with your phone now. I really need to go.
My phone payment app is not working. Is there a cheaper drink I can buy with my cash?

Mia: A small hot soy latte costs less. Your cash is enough for that. Would you like it instead?
Owen: I can wait another minute.
Yes, I will take the hot soy latte instead. Here is my cash.
Mia: Thank you. The cash covers it. Here is your hot soy latte.
I have the hot soy latte now. That works for me. Thank you both.

messages.content:
다음 날 아침, 어제 그 카페 계산대다.
아이스 아메리카노를 시키고 카드를 댔는데 두 번이나 거절됐다.
지갑 속 현금은 눈으로 봐도 조금 모자란다.

Mia: Yes, you can pay with your phone. Please open your payment app and tap it here.
Owen: That is okay. Please try your phone.
Before I pay, do you remember how I wanted my coffee yesterday?

Mia: Yes. You wanted your iced Americano with only a little ice yesterday. I remember.
Owen: That sounds good, but please pay with your phone now. I really need to go.
My phone payment does not work either. I do not want anyone else to pay for me. Please cancel my order.

Mia: All right. I have canceled your order.
Owen: Sorry it did not work out.
My order has been canceled. I am leaving without a drink. Thanks for trying, Mia. Owen, I hope you get to your meeting on time.
